items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Bill Holman did two. And so it was a fun album for us... It was all Bill Holman charts

ctx.x: And Bill Holman did a couple of vocalese things.

Bill Holman did two. And so it was a fun album for us because it got us out of doing the same thing, and you know you like to change what you’re doing. It makes it more interesting, more exciting. And so when we did that Ernie Wilkins wrote the arrangement and at the end he changed it. He thought it would be more effective for a record. Because it’s easy to do a fade out.
